category_title: Children who resist teacher instructions and break classroom rules
scenario_title: Refusing to tidy up toys during classroom transitions
minimal_context: The student is asked to tidy up their toys during a classroom transition to prepare for the next activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our next activity. Please tidy up your toys now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues playing, refusing to tidy up the toys) No, I am not done.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have to follow the classroom routine. Put the toys in the box.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets angry easily and throws a toy on the floor) I don't want to put them away!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to listen to the instructions and clean up.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a tantrum, kicks the toy box, and uses inappropriate language) Stupid teacher! I won't do it!
